steps.title: The program starts
steps.note: Java runs `main()` first. It takes no inputs.

steps.title: Printing a greeting
steps.note: `IO.println` writes a line to the console. Look at **Output** below.

steps.title: The loop starts
steps.note: `int i = 1` creates `i` with the value **1**. Then the loop checks `1 <= 5`. That's true, so it runs the body.

steps.title: First pass
steps.note: `"i = " + i` joins the text and the number, giving `"i = 1"`.

steps.title: Back to the top
steps.note: `i++` adds one, so `i` is now **2**. `2 <= 5` is still true, so the loop goes round again.

steps.title: Three more passes
steps.note: The same thing happens for `i` = 3, 4 and 5.

steps.title: The loop ends
steps.note: `i++` makes `i` **6**. `6 <= 5` is **false**, so the loop stops.

steps.title: Done
steps.note: `main()` reaches its closing brace and the program ends. `i` only existed inside the loop, so it's gone.
